policy: Each entry accepts exactly one HIGH/CRITICAL finding (id + package) for the listed images until review_by; runtime entries also bind the exact installed version. Expired, unjustified or version-mismatched entries fail scripts/ops_image_audit.py. Never add an entry for a finding whose fix is available in the pinned suite: rebuild instead.

accepted.justification: Backend Chromium is Playwright 1.64.0's pinned build (156.0.8078.4); 1.64.0 is the newest Playwright and the version is owned by uv.lock (dependency lane). Hosted browser tasks run in the sandbox image, which ships stable 156.0.8078.47; the backend binary is used only by native/REPL mode, which must not browse untrusted sites in hosted deployments. Remove when Playwright ships a 156 stable-or-newer build.
accepted.title: Bundled Chromium is older than current Linux stable 156.0.8078.47

accepted.justification: Node 24.21.0 is the driver bundled inside the uv.lock-pinned Playwright 1.64.0 wheel; it only speaks to the parent Python process over stdio pipes and never parses network input itself. Fixed by a Playwright upgrade owned by the dependency lane; /usr/local/bin/node (agent host) is on 22.23.4, the latest security release.
accepted.title: Node.js misses security release(s) 24.22.1

accepted.justification: Chromium links libcups for print dialogs; Debian lists these unfixed. The CVEs need a malicious CUPS/IPP server or shared queue: no cupsd runs, no printer is configured, and sandbox egress is policy-restricted.

accepted.justification: Essential Debian base package from the official python slim image; Debian lists it unfixed. Affected code is mount/nsenter/login/lastlog administration paths. Images never mount untrusted filesystems or offer logins; network-facing processes run as non-root (backend uid 10001; sandbox Chromium/socat/Xvfb as sandboxuser) in containers started with no-new-privileges and without CAP_SYS_ADMIN (backend additionally cap_drop ALL).

Sandbox: Xvfb listens only on its local unix socket (-nolisten tcp) in a per-task container and its only client is the same-uid Chromium, so this is post-browser-compromise only. Backend: installed by `playwright install --with-deps` but never started (Chromium launches headless).
